theorem mvcc.rep_one (P : IProp GF) : ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate (2 - 1) (), P) ⊢ P

theorem mvcc.histOf_mono {L L' : mvcc.Log} (h : L <+: L') : mvcc.histOf L <+: mvcc.histOf L'

theorem mvcc.restoreViewOut_bucketView (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (q : Qp) (R : mvcc.Log) :
    mvcc.restoreViewOut γ q R ⊢ mvcc.bucketView γ q (mvcc.bucketMap ([[], []] ++ R))

theorem mvcc.histOfFrom_append_log (i : Nat) (A B : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.histOfFrom i (A ++ B) =
    mvcc.histOfFrom i A ++ mvcc.histOfFrom (i + List.length A) B

theorem mvcc.logAuth_gather (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (l : mvcc.Log) : (mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx (Qp.half
    1) l ∗ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx (mvcc.revQ γ 1) l ∗ if γ.watchQ = true then mvcc.logQ γ l else
    True) ⊢ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx 1 l

theorem mvcc.kbViewC_halves (kb : Option mvcc.KBReal) (γb : GName) (m : mvcc.Bucket) : mvcc.kbViewC
    kb γb 1 m ⊢ mvcc.kbViewC kb γb (Qp.half 1) m ∗ mvcc.kbViewC kb γb (Qp.half 1) m

theorem mvcc.logAuth_split (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (l : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx 1 l ⊢
    mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx (Qp.half 1) l ∗ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx (mvcc.revQ γ 1) l ∗ if γ.watchQ =
    true then mvcc.logQ γ l else True

def mvcc.restoreWriter (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L' : mvcc.Log) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ntok,
      "Hclog" ∷ ghostVar γ.clog (Qp.half 1) L' ∗
        "Hlw" ∷ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx (Qp.half 1) L' ∗
          "Htoks" ∷ ownTokAuthDfrac γ.revs (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ntok ∗
            "%Hbudget" ∷ ⌜List.length L' + ntok + 3 ≤ 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗
              "Hlrd" ∷ lease.lessorRdOf γ.leases ∗
                "Hhist" ∷ monoListAuthOwn γ.idx.hist (Qp.half 1) (mvcc.histOf L') ∗ "#Hcert" ∷ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx L')

theorem mvcc.rep_take1 (P : IProp GF) : ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate mvcc.nReaders (), P) ⊢ P ∗
    [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate (mvcc.nReaders - 1) (), P

theorem mvcc.restore_finish (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o' : mvcc.StoreObjs) (p' :
    mvcc.PhysNames) (L' : mvcc.Log) (hwf : mvcc.IdxWf L' []) (hne : L' ≠ []) : ⊢ £ 1 -∗
    mvcc.writerInv s γ -∗ mvcc.curAt (γ.withPhys p') (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1).half.half) o' -∗
    mvcc.restoreWriter γ L' -∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"currentRev" s) (W64 (↑(List.length L') - 1))
    (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) -∗ ⧖(mvcc.logCh L') -∗ monoNatLbOwn p'.nev (mvcc.evsOf (L' ++
    [[]])).length -∗ ghostVar p'.wk 1 () -∗ ghostVar p'.wv 1 L' -∗ mvcc.bucketViewL (γ.withPhys p')
    (Qp.half 1).half.half L' -∗ mvcc.compactRes (γ.withPhys p') L' -∗ mvcc.kbRegRight p'.kb ={⊤}=∗
    ghostVar γ.wr 1 () ∗ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx L' ∗ mvcc.writerReg s (γ.withPhys p')

theorem mvcc.restoreView_of (b : GoInterface) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (RT : IProp GF) (q : Qp) (R :
    mvcc.Log) : mvcc.bucketViewC γ q (mvcc.bucketMap ([[], []] ++ R)) ∗ mvcc.keyCleanRead b
    (mvcc.bucketViewC γ) RT (mvcc.kbNoCmp γ.kb γ.bucket) ⊢ mvcc.restoreView b γ RT q R

theorem mvcc.histShape_nil (L : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.histShape L [] = mvcc.histOf L

def mvcc.restoreHeld (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L' : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("Hclog" ∷ ghostVar γ.clog 1 L' ∗
      "Hlog" ∷ mvcc.idxLogAuth γ.idx 1 L' ∗
        "Htoks" ∷ ownTokAuth γ.revs 0 ∗
          "Hcrev" ∷ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx (Qp.half 1).half c ∗
            "Hlrd" ∷ lease.lessorRdOf γ.leases ∗
              "Hhist" ∷ monoListAuthOwn γ.idx.hist (Qp.half 1) (mvcc.histOf L') ∗
                "#Hhlb" ∷ monoListLbOwn γ.idx.hist (mvcc.histOf L') ∗ "#Hllb" ∷ monoListLbOwn γ.idx.log L')

theorem mvcc.typedPointsto_halves {V : Type} [TypedPointsto V] (l : Loc) (v : V) (q : Qp) :
    typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own q) ⊣⊢ typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own q.half) ∗ typedPointsto l v
    (DFrac.own q.half)

theorem mvcc.restore_takeover (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) (L L' : mvcc.Log)
    (c : Int) (hLL : L <+: L') (hc : -1 ≤ c) : ⊢ £ 1 -∗ mvcc.writerInv s γ -∗ mvcc.revMuInv s γ 1 -∗

    ghostVar γ.wr 1 () -∗ mvcc.idxCert γ.idx L -∗ ownToks γ.revs (2 ^ 63 - 3 - List.length L) -∗ (if
    γ.watchQ = true then mvcc.logQ γ L else True) -∗ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx (Qp.half 1).half c -∗
    typedPointsto (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"compactMainRev"
    s) (W64 c) (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ={⊤}=∗ (∃ v, typedPointsto (structFieldRef
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"currentRev" s) v (DFrac.own 1)) ∗ typedPointsto
    (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"compactMainRev" s) (W64 c)
    (DFrac.own 1) ∗ dghostVar γ.rst (DFrac.own 1) false ∗ mvcc.curAt γ (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) o ∗
    mvcc.curAt γ (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1).half.half) o ∗ mvcc.curAt γ (DFrac.own (Qp.half
    1).half.half) o ∗ mvcc.crevUB γ.idx (Qp.half 1).half c ∗ mvcc.restoreHeld γ L' c ∗ monoListLbOwn
    γ.idx.hist (mvcc.histShape L' [])

theorem mvcc.rep_split (P : IProp GF) (a b : Nat) : ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate (a + b) (), P) ⊣⊢
    ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate a (), P) ∗ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate b (), P

theorem mvcc.idxSlots_out (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (o : mvcc.StoreObjs) (n : Nat) : ([∗list] _x ∈
    List.replicate n (), mvcc.idxSlot γ o) ⊢ ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate n (), mvcc.idxReader o.ti
    γ.idx) ∗ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate n (), mvcc.storeRT γ
